ACPBench is a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in the context of Action, Change, and Planning. It spans 13 diverse domains:

Blocksworld
Logistics
Grippers 
Grid 
Ferry
FloorTile
Rovers
VisitAll
Depot
Goldminer
Satellite
Swap
Alfworld
